title: API Protection Sample
description: This page compares behavior for the protected /backend/health endpoint when session cookies are sent vs not sent.

allowed.title: Pass Case
allowed.description: Call with credentials: include to send session cookies. If you are signed in, 200 is expected.

blocked.title: Blocked Case
blocked.description: Call with credentials: omit so no cookies are sent. Since the API is protected, 401 is expected.

states.emptyAllowed: Not executed yet. Click the button above to call with cookies.
states.emptyBlocked: Not executed yet. Click the button above to call without cookies.
